summary: v52j — Signatory magic-link claim now sets its own session cookie + csrf cookie and returns the bearer+csrf in body, so the frontend no longer needs a second /auth/login call. Eliminates the HTTP 401 that appeared immediately after a successful password set.

verification.claim_response: Returns 200 with id, email, name, institution_ids, token, csrf_token.
verification.cookies_dropped_by_claim: Both escrow_sig_token and csrf_token are set on the claim response.
verification.me_with_claim_session: GET /escrow-signatories/auth/me returns 200 using only the cookies set by /claim.
verification.standalone_login_regression: Fresh session login with just email+password after claim still returns 200.
